question: Will the U.S. unemployment rate (BLS, seasonally adjusted) for May 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-05-15) be above 4.2%, its value for March 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-04-15 (March 2025), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
